notes.title: Patch note 19/06/25
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45648604/bc0b7c08b9e3c86fe5832900f10d2a944f54313c.jpg"]



Hello everyone. 

New small patch today to address some minor issues and improvements to the game : 


-added a small VFX effect when digging

-fixed a protagonist's voice volume who was too low. 

-added a sound reverb system that should better render sound changes depending on the size of the room you're in. 

-fixed many timing in voicelines

-fixed a bug that caused certain voice lines to re-trigger when pressing "continue" in the menu

-fixed shadows missing in intro scene. 



Happy Digging

Yoirgl

notes.title: 💥 JOIN THE BETA, YA SCRUFFY STONE-LOVER 💥
notes.content:
Oi, you! Yeah, you with the pickaxe and no sense of self-preservation!

We’re calling all shovel-swingers, grappling-hook-gliders, and beer-guzzling brutes to join the OFFICIAL BETA of Only DWARVES DIG Proper HOLES! 🍻

What’s in it for you, you ask?  
We’ll give you the game.  
For free.  
Yes. Like, actually free. No gold coins. No IOUs. Just glorious dwarven gameplay shoved right into your Steam library.

All we ask in return?  
Your HONEST feedback.  
Tell us what made you laugh, cry, or scream into your mining helmet. We promise to listen (unless it's about nerfing the grappling hook—never).

But first, you need to  JOIN OUR DISCORD and ask for your beta key.  
We’ll hand it over like a frothy pint at the tavern—no questions asked (okay maybe one or two).

---

🪓 JOIN OUR DISCORD 🪓  
Click here, beardling 👉 Discord

Meet other testers. Request your beta key. Share your most explosive hole-digging fails. Post memes. Argue about whether dwarves should wear pants. All the good stuff.

---

⛏️ So what do you need?

 A VR headset  
 A sense of adventure  
 A love for digging  
 And at least 1 (one) working eye to spot danger or treasure (optional, but preferred)  


---

The beta is limited, so grab your spot faster than a goblin grabs unguarded loot.  
We’ll see you in the tunnels, tester. Just remember:

DIG DEEP. DRINK BEER. REPORT BUGS.

—The Devs  
(Still stuck in a hole. Send help.)

notes.title: Patch notes 17/06/25
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45648604/bc0b7c08b9e3c86fe5832900f10d2a944f54313c.jpg"]



New update : 

-renamed "energy" into "beer" on the upgrade panel

-increased the starting beer level by 50%

-reorganized the upgrade panel to have Save and Menu buttons at the top

-reworked the movement system to try and limit the stuttering when using the smooth rotation setting

-introduction of a light management system that should limit the inconvenience of having torches close-by turning off. 

-fixed a bug that caused the "unmovable rock" voice-line to trigger when digging normally, particularly in the tutorial.
